origin.rpm_adaptation: Unnumbered native full sweep follows actual RPM / current bike maximum RPM.
origin.light_thresholds: Normalized to current bike maximum; fifth light at 0.775 matches red-zone entry, retaining donor relative spacing and frame-based blink.
origin.color_limit: Native face/needle color 128 may be neutral with Climax shader gain; external shader not supplied. Raw artwork retained.

restoration.method: Reviewed generated artwork with original logical geometry, telemetry and color settings.
restoration.shared_font: MotoGP06 and URT2 original glyph metrics and binary masks match; original alpha encoding differs.
restoration.note: Visual restoration, not pixel-identical donor artwork.
